messages:
Maya (People Ops): Quick notice — we updated the employee handbook section on caregiver/parental leave to clarify intermittent leave eligibility and how it coordinates with short-term disability. Please review and acknowledge if you own manager approvals. Handbook: https://docs.redwoodinc.com/people/handbook/caregiver-leave :page_facing_up:

Maya (People Ops): Also published a ~10min microlearning for managers and manager-facing ICs. Completion required by Apr 12. Tracker + LMS link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Care-Tracker

Lina (Legal): Reviewed and left a small comment about examples for "eligible caregiver". No legal blocker — we can snapshot after the edit. Note: EU acknowledgements must be retained for 3 years.

Sam R (Eng Manager): Quick Q — do vendor contractors who make hiring decisions need to complete the module? Some contracts limit trainings.

Jules (HR Support): Mandatory for W-2 employees and contractors with people-decision authority. If a vendor contract prohibits training, escalate to people-ops@redwood for an exception. We'll add a contractor flag column in the tracker.

Maya (People Ops): Action items: 1) Managers list teams in Col B by Mar 30, 2) RSVP for optional Q&A (Tue 11am PT / Thu 4pm PT) in Col G, 3) Managers + manager-facing ICs complete module by Apr 12. We will import LMS completions on Apr 13 and reconcile.

Sam R (Eng Manager): Can initial manager ack be an emoji in the sheet? I can only click quickly during 1:1s. :thumbsup:

Maya (People Ops): Emoji is fine for initial ack. For audit we need a timestamped confirmation; people-ops will populate timestamps when we reconcile imports.

HR-bot: Reminder scheduled — automated manager reminders for unconfirmed teams will go out Apr 5.

Maya (People Ops): Reminder: do not post medical or PHI in Slack. Use the secure intake form linked on the handbook page for any documentation. Thanks! :heart:
